hooks.prompt:
A git commit was just run in this repository: $ARGUMENTS
If it did not create a commit (a dry run, or it failed), answer ok. Otherwise read the commit with git show --stat HEAD and git show HEAD, then run the docs check in section 7 of .claude/skills/orchestrator/SKILL.md on that one commit. If no document needs a change, answer ok. Otherwise answer not ok and list each document with the reason, ids and paths only, never a secret or personal data.
